title: Human · fingertip touch
input: A plate moves against a finger. The apparatus records force along three axes, and an electrode records spikes from one sensory nerve fibre. Each row covers 20 ms.
horizon: History 200 ms · Forecast the count from 20 to 40 ms after the last input
forecast: Expected spikes in one 20 ms interval. An average below one is possible because many intervals contain zero spikes.
